observations: 2 photos show a light-colored (beige/cream) 2-seater couch/sofa with rounded arms and a simple boxy back.
Upholstery appears smooth and mostly intact; no obvious large tears visible in these angles.
Photo 1 shows the seat cushion and arm area; there are faint marks/uneven coloration that could be wear or lighting.
No visible brand/model label, tag, or manufacturer markings in the photos.

claims.claim: Very neat 2 seater couch for sale
claims.evidence: Photos show a generally clean-looking sofa, but only two angles are provided and there’s no close-up of stitching, underside, or any hidden damage.

risks.risk: Hidden damage to upholstery (small tears, worn seams, or punctures) not visible from these angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all seams/stitching, both arm corners, and the underside/back edge.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with possible minor wear (not assumed to be flawless).

risks.risk: Staining/odor or pet smoke smell that photos cannot confirm.
risks.proof: Seller should provide a short video sniff/air-check in a well-lit room and show any stain areas under natural light.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if it may need cleaning (not assumed odor-free).

risks.risk: Cushion sagging or weak springs/frame (photos don’t show bounce/support).
risks.proof: Video showing the seller pressing down on the seat and back to demonstrate firmness, plus a photo of the frame/legs.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as average condition (not assumed firm/like-new).

risks.risk: Color mismatch or fading (lighting can make it look cleaner/brighter than it is).
risks.proof: Photo taken in daylight from the same distance for both seat and back, plus a close-up of fabric texture.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as standard used upholstery (not assumed fully fresh color).

proof_requests: Close-up photos of stitching/seams on both arms and along the back/seat edges.
A short video showing seat firmness (press test) and back support.
Photos of the underside/legs and any frame damage or loose joints.
Daylight photos to confirm true color and any stains/marks.
response.reason: The sofa type is clear (2-seater couch), but key condition factors that affect Lagos resale value—stitching integrity, cushion firmness, and any stains/odor—aren’t provable from these two limited angles.
